text: Last week, while we were preparing to push back, I got a call from the purser. One of the passengers was yelling at another passenger. I immediately called for security to come onto the plane to take the passenger off. The passenger was very big and heavy, so there was quite a struggle. But eventually, he was taken off and we were able to be on our way. Why did security have to come onto the plane?
